tip.title: firecrawl/firecrawl
tip.body:
当你的Agent需要从网页中提取结构化数据（如商品价格、新闻标题），而目标网站没有API时，可以用Firecrawl的`crawl_url`方法直接抓取并解析。做法：安装`firecrawl-py`，调用`app.crawl_url(url, {'pageOptions': {'onlyMainContent': True}})`，返回的Markdown可直接喂给LLM。注意设置`maxDepth=1`避免爬取过多页面。

```python
from firecrawl import FirecrawlApp

app = FirecrawlApp(api_key='your_key')
result = app.crawl_url('https://example.com', params={'maxDepth': 1})
print(result['data'][0]['content'])  # 纯文本内容
```

items.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses
items.raw_text: Training AI agents with reinforcement learning can be challenging because their tools, context, and decision-making are managed by complex frameworks. Agent Lightning connects existing agents to RL training, making it easier to improve them without rebuilding them. The post Agent Lightning v1.0: A 3,500-Line Lightweight Agentic RL Framework for Training Agents with Real Harnesses appeared first on Microsoft Research .
